text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi tham gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi.
Faasle chahe jitne bhi rahein darmiyaan,
Yeh khamoshi bhi toh koi bewafa nahi.
Bas tumhara naam hi honton pe rehta hai,
Har ik saans mein tera hi ehsaas rehta hai.
title: Adhuri Kahani
description: A soft and heartfelt poem about unspoken love and silent feelings that linger in the heart.
